claims.statement: Tom Allen fought Joe Goss on September 7, 1876, near Cincinnati, in a ring moved to Boone County, Kentucky.

claims.statement: Tom Allen lost his fight with Joe Goss on a deliberate foul.
claims.excerpt: Allen lost the fight on a deliberate foul.

claims.statement: Tom Allen and Joe Goss were arrested after the fight and released on bail.
Eph Holland, a Cincinnati sporting man, was in charge of the affair for the fight between Tom Allen and Joe Goss.
claims.excerpt: Eph Holland, a Cincinnati sporting man.

claims.statement: Tom Allen had come to the United States from England some years before 1876.
claims.excerpt: come to this country from Engiand some

claims.statement: Tom Allen died in St. Louis about one month before this article was printed.

fights.excerpt: Allen lost the fight on a deliberate foul.
fights.notes: Allen knocked Goss down in round 21, then struck him while down; Holland gave the verdict to Goss.

notes: Recollection of the 1876 fight, reprinted in 1903. Ring was on the farm of the father of horseman Rome Respass (printed Home Respass). OCR garbled in places.
